scope: Close only the round-311 selector, fused-store, runtime-coverage, flag-lineage, codec-coverage, and early unsupported-backend findings. The packed representation, attention readers, serving performance, memory claim, and model weights remain out of scope.

selector.conflict: Reject when the reserved packed flag is present in any form or F16 compact cache is active.
selector.backend: Reject enabled diagnostic during graph allocation on non-CUDA builds.

required: A compiled DS4_TEST_HOOKS test executes the production selector into the graph-owned field for unset, 0, 1, empty, malformed, reserved-name conflict, and F16 conflict cases.
The ordinary and fused CUDA wrappers each execute independently and expose separate synchronized completed-row counts.
Each wrapper matches an independent CPU E2M1 oracle; the fused oracle also includes RMS normalization and norm weights.

Coverage includes deterministic public-fixed pseudo-random finite rows, zero and signed zero, all positive and negative exact midpoints plus nextafter neighbors at unit and non-unit scale, saturation, two rows, a nonzero tail position, exact buffers, adjacent canaries, and undersized-buffer rejection.
Unset and explicit zero remain byte-identical F32 stores and leave E2M1 counters at zero.
Mutating the selector, ordinary branch, or fused branch independently makes the fixed test fail.
compiled_microgate.failure: Any unexecuted path, oracle mismatch, changed RoPE byte, canary write, accepted malformed selector, unsynchronized/mismatched count, or green mutation is FAIL.

required_before_scoring: Exactly one startup line identifies the resolved diagnostic mode for each process.
A synchronized shutdown attestation reports separate ordinary and fused completed-row counts.
Baseline arms report mode off and both counts zero; candidate arms report mode on and nonzero total coverage, with the path mix fixed by the selected scorer configuration.
At least one paired case has a nonzero raw candidate-vs-baseline metric difference; otherwise the candidate arm is treated as inactive and FAIL, not as perfect fidelity.
nll_runtime_binding.quality_formula: Use the existing fixed 100-case paired scorer: token-weighted delta NLL <= 0.01; one-sided 95% upper bound <= 0.01; top-1 loss and one-sided 95% upper bound <= 0.005; deterministic candidate rerun.
nll_runtime_binding.authority: A statistical PASS authorizes only packed-reader implementation. Any nonzero fidelity delta and later performance/memory purchase still require owner adoption.
